client_provided.description: Deloitte FDE assignment dataset — Q1 2026 deal activity. Used as the ground truth for all attainment, pipeline, and loss-reason analysis.
client_provided.note: Treated as confidential client data. Not transmitted to LLM — only pandas-computed summaries reach the formatter.

client_provided.description: Rep roster with quotas, managers, and hire dates. Used for attainment math and manager attribution chain.

synthetic.description: Stress-test dataset generated by gen_synthetic.py. 15 injected anomalies: duplicate IDs, $0-value deals, unknown stage values, orphaned rep_ids, temporal inversions.
synthetic.why: The provided FDE dataset is clean by design. Synthetic data confirms the eval suite catches real-world data quality failures that the clean dataset would never surface.
synthetic.note: Never used in production answers. eval.py Phase 1a runs against the provided dataset only.

events.label: Data schema contract — D1–D9 checks; server aborts on any violation
events.desc: 9 schema assertions run before any analysis: required columns present (D1-D2), deal_value + quota numeric and positive (D3-D5), canonical stage values only (D6), all rep_ids resolve (D7), no duplicate deal IDs (D8), loss_reason null rate ≤20% on Closed Lost (D9). If any fail, Phase 1b (computed facts) and the server never start.

events.label: Dataset loaded — 75 deals, 10 reps, Q1 2026 quota targets ingested
events.desc: Raw CSV → pandas DataFrames. Enterprise attainment 58.57%, Mid-Market 56.4%. Ironbridge loss_reason = null confirmed.

events.label: Integrity gate — 5 fact assertions guard every server start
events.desc: Enterprise attainment ~58.6%, Ironbridge null loss_reason, at-risk reps present, pipeline >$4M, coverage math chain. Server refuses to start if any assertion fails.

events.label: Trust architecture — pre-LLM compute layer; LLM formats prose only
events.desc: All numbers computed by pandas before LLM sees them. LLM role: classify intent + format prose. Never calculates. This is the architectural answer to the hallucination failure.

events.label: 8 intent gates — pre-LLM short-circuit on known failure modes
events.desc: segment_attainment, rep_risk, pipeline_close_date, pipeline_coverage, win_rate, competitive_analysis, rep_correlation, discovery. Each fires before LLM call with pandas-computed payload.

events.label: Traceable source citations — OPP-XX / REP-XX IDs on every answer
events.desc: Every response includes source IDs the CCO can verify. Not ‘based on your data’ — specific deal and rep records. /source/{id} endpoint resolves any ID to its raw row.

events.label: 4 declared failure modes — PREDICTIVE / UNDEFINED / COMPOUND / UNANSWERABLE
events.desc: System knows its limits and says so. Each mode returns debug object with failure_type + reformulations. No silent degradation.

events.label: Deloitte rubric eval — 10/10 passing incl. Ironbridge CRITICAL
events.desc: eval_rubric.py: all 4 official assignment queries pass. E4 (Ironbridge unanswerable) confirmed: confidence=unanswerable, zero fabricated figures. Definition of done for the assignment.

events.label: Vector cache + FAQ warm — 16 pre-computed responses at startup
events.desc: Jaccard + containment similarity. Cache bypassed for rep-named queries (personalised). Startup warms 16 FAQ entries in background thread.

events.label: Rep routing precision — last-name / first-name / full-name all resolve correctly
events.desc: 'marsh' → rep_summary (REP-06). 'kevin' → Kevin Marsh. 'enterprise' → segment_attainment (not a rep). Three separate routing gates, no cross-fire.

events.label: Extended eval suite — E11–E25, 33 invariants, JTBD annotations
events.desc: E11: cold onboarding (open-ended discovery). E15: rep correlation (tenure gap, coverage gap, Lisa Park anomaly). E18: compound query graceful decline. E25: multi-rep comparison refusal without hallucination.

events.label: Behavioral economics layer — Prospect Theory + Go board strategy
events.desc: Kahneman-Tversky (λ=2.25, α=β=0.88). Reference point = quota. Loss domain = risk-seeking. Go status per rep: ALIVE/FIGHTING/DEAD GROUP. CCO sente moves ranked by expected fleet impact.

events.label: Nash equilibrium signaling — Liar’s Poker between managers
events.desc: 3-manager game: David Kim INFLATED (1.74x coverage absorbs exposure), Reyes/Huang SANDBAGGED (dead zone too high). Mixed equilibrium = channel fog. Death spiral: 0 triggers in 10K trials, 100% stagnation at P50=87.1%.

events.label: Commission reform pro-forma — 4 structures, ROI at 30% behavioral lift
events.desc: CURRENT (0/6/12%), NO_CLIFF (6/12%), LINEAR (8% flat), RAMP (4/7/13%). RAMP best ROI: 1.2x at 30% lift, 0.8 month payback. Dead-zone pipeline at risk: $201K (3.4pp fleet miss). Commission delta = option mechanics.

events.label: Architecture review — Type A/B/C analysis routing, architect-validated
events.desc: Type A (queryable): V×C×S, Bayesian CIs, dead-zone commission → query pipeline. Type B (panels): wargame, proforma, prospect_go, liarpoker → /analysis/* endpoints. Type C (CLI): redteam, synthetic. 5 failure modes enumerated.

events.label: Full suite 25/25 — all Deloitte criteria passing, demo-ready
events.desc: 25 eval cases + 33 invariants. E1 Enterprise 58.57%. E2 Rivera/Marsh/Cole. E3 pipeline dollar figure. E4 Ironbridge unanswerable, no fabricated data. Interactive runtime.py REPL for live analysis.

risks.how: Pre-LLM pandas compute — LLM never sees raw numbers
risks.note: Meridian’s prior AI tool hallucinated figures and lost CCO trust. Architecture inverts the pattern: pandas computes, LLM formats prose only.

risks.how: Pre-LLM UNANSWERABLE gate — short-circuits before any LLM call
risks.note: Ironbridge loss_reason is null. System detects this analytically and returns confidence=unanswerable. Verified in 10K eval runs: zero fabricated figures.

risks.risk: Rep name misrouted to segment query
risks.how: Pre-LLM rep-name gate fires before segment intent classification
risks.note: 'marsh' would return Enterprise segment data without the gate. Rep lookup fires first, bypasses vector cache for personalised accuracy.

risks.risk: Commission cliff creating $201K at-risk pipeline (3.4pp miss)
risks.how: RAMP structure removes cliff — 1.2x ROI at 30% behavioral lift
risks.note: Dead-zone reps earn $0 marginal commission below 50% quota. Commission delta = 0% = deep OTM call. RAMP structure is the cheapest fix at $146K incremental cost.

risks.risk: Fleet morale death spiral — borderline trigger conditions active
risks.how: Remove cliff → restore delta → restore marginal incentive
risks.note: 10K Monte Carlo: 0 spirals triggered but 100% stagnation. P50 fleet attainment 87.1%. Trigger threshold: morale < 0.55 AND dead-zone fraction > 40%. Currently borderline.

findings.lab: Architecture: Type A/B/C analysis routing — architect-validated
findings.desc: Queryable intelligence → query pipeline. Framework panels → /analysis/* endpoints. Dev tooling → CLI only.

findings.lab: Commission reform pro-forma — RAMP structure best ROI (1.2x)
findings.desc: 4 commission structures modeled. RAMP (4/7/13%) dominates on ROI at standard behavioral lift assumptions.

findings.lab: Prospect Theory (λ=2.25) — loss domain = risk-seeking on quota cliff
findings.desc: KT value function applied to rep quota positions. Dead-zone reps in loss domain behave risk-seeking (fight/quit, not steady grind). Paralysis index = fight_force × pivot_force.
E1–E25 plus invariant layer. JTBD annotations on every case. Next-analysis chips verified. No false positives on unanswerable gate.

findings.lab: Nash equilibrium: David Kim INFLATED, Reyes/Huang SANDBAGGED
findings.desc: Analytic payoff matrix (not Monte Carlo) confirms mixed equilibrium. CCO navigating with broken altimeter. Decision friction drag at 40% dead zone: -17.7pp combined velocity penalty.

findings.lab: Rep routing precision — 3 name formats, zero segment cross-fire
findings.desc: Last-name, first-name, full-name all route to rep_summary. 'enterprise' correctly routes to segment_attainment. Verified E21–E24.

findings.lab: Deloitte rubric eval — 10/10, Ironbridge CRITICAL pass
findings.desc: eval_rubric.py = definition of done for assignment. 4 official queries + critical edge cases. 0 CRITICAL failures.

findings.lab: 4 failure modes — PREDICTIVE / UNDEFINED / COMPOUND / UNANSWERABLE
findings.desc: Each mode has a debug object with failure_type + reformulations. E16 predictive, E17 undefined metric, E18 compound, E4 unanswerable. All verified in eval suite.

findings.lab: Traceable source citations — OPP-XX / REP-XX on every response
findings.desc: /source/{id} resolves any citation to its raw data row. Not ‘based on your data’ — specific records the CCO can verify.

findings.lab: Trust architecture — pre-LLM compute, zero fabrication surface
findings.desc: Pandas computes all numbers. LLM receives structured payload, returns formatted prose. Zero path where LLM can hallucinate a figure.

findings.lab: Vector cache — Jaccard + containment, rep-named bypass
findings.desc: 16 FAQ entries warmed at startup. Personalised queries (rep-named) bypass cache for accuracy. Cache invalidation: none needed — data is static CSV.

findings.lab: Data schema contract — D1–D9, abort on violation
findings.desc: 9 checks: required columns (D1-D2), numeric types (D3-D5), canonical stages (D6), referential integrity (D7), no duplicate IDs (D8), loss_reason null rate ≤20% (D9). Runs before fact assertions. Schema failure = server abort.

findings.lab: 5-assertion integrity gate — server refuses to start on data corruption
findings.desc: Enterprise attainment, Ironbridge null check, at-risk reps present, pipeline floor, coverage math chain. Zero-tolerance boot: any assertion failure = SystemExit(1).

findings.lab: Interactive runtime.py REPL — toggle log mode, run any analysis
findings.desc: python3 runtime.py: server starts in background thread, REPL in foreground. Commands: q <query>, eval, eval rubric, eval synthetic, insights, wargame, commission, proforma, prospect, liarpoker, bayes, redteam, log (toggle verbose), health, cache.
